title: The evaluate reserve tests compare the word-only envelope against a reserve that now includes the focus disclosure
outcome: The evaluate reserve tests compare the word-only envelope against a reserve that now includes the focus disclosure
acceptance: The evaluate reserve derivation guards in src/verbs/tests/evaluate/review.rs assert the word-only envelope against EVALUATE_WORD_RESERVE minus FOCUS_CHANGE_RESERVE (or against a separately named word-only constant), so the word envelope cannot grow into the room reserved for the focus disclosure without a test failing

completion.summary: The evaluate reserve guards now measure the word-only envelope against a named EVALUATE_WORD_ONLY_RESERVE (3072). EVALUATE_WORD_RESERVE is that plus the focus-disclosure reserve, so the envelope can't grow into the disclosure's room unnoticed. Landed as 3d52ed6.
